title: InventoryCopy
description:
This project Makes you save inventories from other servers and export it in to your own!!!

You can save in any survival server and then you can Only Export it in creative
body:
# InventoryCopy

InventoryCopy is a Fabric client-side utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that lets you save inventory templates and restore them later when you are legitimately in creative mode.

It is designed for builders, kit testing, private creative servers, practice worlds, and players who want to copy their own inventory layouts between worlds without manually rebuilding them every time.

Important: Not A Cheat Mod

InventoryCopy does not bypass servers, anticheats, permissions, or survival inventory rules.

Minecraft servers are server-authoritative. This mod can save your inventory anywhere, but it can only export items when the server/client allows creative inventory actions. It will not give items in survival, PvP, adventure mode, or on servers where you do not have creative permissions.

Features

Save your current inventory as a named template.
Restore saved inventories in creative mode.
Preserves item layout exactly.
Saves armor and restores it into armor slots.
Saves offhand item.
Preserves enchantments, durability, custom names, and modern item component data.
Saves selected hotbar slot.
Quick-save keybind, default L.
Quick-export keybind, default O.
Automatic quick-save names like Inv1, Inv2, Inv3.
Mod Menu settings screen.
Black themed settings GUI.
Keybinds section for editing quick-save and quick-export settings.
Inventories section with saved inventory list.
Sort inventories by newest or oldest.
Rename saved inventories.
Set an inventory as the quick-export target.
Delete saved inventories.
Export directly from the inventory manager.
Commands

/inventory save <name>
Saves your current inventory, armor, offhand, item layout, enchants, durability, and item data.

/inventory list
Shows all saved inventories.

/inventory export <name>
Restores the saved inventory. This only works while you are in creative mode.

/inventory delete <name>
Deletes a saved inventory.

/inventory rename <oldName> <newName>
Renames a saved inventory.

Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Mod Menu is optional, but recommended for the settings GUI
Author

Developed by MrSuhrem
